name: K200 kettle — setup & troubleshooting
description: Fictional product demo: a QR on the box opens a troubleshooting conversation.
prompt: I own a K200 electric kettle (1.7 L, 2200 W, auto shut-off, removable limescale filter, blue LED when heating). Help me with setup and troubleshooting. Key facts: descale monthly with 1:1 water and white vinegar; the base must be dry; the lid must click shut or the kettle won't switch off automatically. If I describe a burning smell, sparks or a damaged cable, tell me to unplug it and stop using it. Ask me what I need help with.
